title: Honey-Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Combine honey, peanut butter, eggs, water and vanilla in bowl and beat to blend well. Stir in rolled oats and raisins.
Sift flour, soda and salt together into mixture and stir to blend. Chill about 30 minutes.
Heat oven to 350 degrees. Grease cookie sheets.
Drop dough by large teaspoonfuls on cookie sheets, leaving about 2 inches between.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until tops spring back when touched lightly. (Cookies will spread during baking and will be chewy when cool.) Remove from pans while hot and cool on racks. (Makes 8 doz.)
notes: Newspaper clipping taped to a lined card
Makes 8 doz.
raw_text:
HONEY-PEANUT BUTTER
COOKIES
2 cups liquid honey
1 1/2 cups chunk-style peanut butter
3 eggs
1 tbsp. water
2 tsp. vanilla
1 1/2 cups quick cooking rolled oats
2 cups seeded raisins, halved
1 1/2 cups sifted all-purpose flour
1 tsp. soda
1 tsp. salt
Combine honey, peanut butter,
eggs, water and vanilla in bowl and
beat to blend well. Stir in rolled oats
and raisins.
Sift flour, soda and salt together
into mixture and stir to blend. Chill
about 30 minutes.
Heat oven to 350 degrees. Grease
cookie sheets.
Drop dough by large teaspoonfuls
on cookie sheets, leaving about 2
inches between.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until tops
spring back when touched lightly.
(Cookies will spread during baking
and will be chewy when cool.) Re-
move from pans while hot and cool
on racks. (Makes 8 doz.)

title: Chicken-Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 2 10 oz pkgs. frozen broccoli or 1 bunch fresh broccoli, uncooked
Bread crumbs or Pepperidge Farm Herb dressing mix (1/2 c minimum)
directions: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish or 3 qt. casserole. Cook frozen broccoli until almost tender; drain. Place in baking dish and cover with the large chicken pieces.
Combined soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice, and curry powder; pour over chicken. Sprinkle cheddar cheese over top.
Combine dressing or bread crumbs with butter and sprinkle over top.
Bake at 350° at least 30 minutes, or until desired doneness. Serves 6-8.
NOTE: This recipe can be prepared and refrigerated over night. Warm a bit before baking or add a few minutes to baking time.
notes: Written on torn spiral-notebook paper (two overlapping sheets in photo)
Serves 6-8

Chicken - Broccoli Casserole
2 10oz pkgs. frozen broccoli or 1 bunch fresh
broccoli, uncooked
3c cooked chicken (large pieces)
2 cans cream of chicken soup
1c mayonnaise
1/2c milk
1/2 - 1 Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2 tsp. curry powder
3/4 lb. (1/2c) grated cheddar cheese
Bread crumbs or Pepperidge Farm Herb dressing
mix (1/2c minimum)
1-4 Tbsp melted butter
Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish or 3 qt.
casserole. Cook frozen broccoli until almost
tender; drain. Place in baking dish and
cover with the large chicken pieces. Combined
soup, mayonnaise, lemon juice, and curry
powder; pour over chicken. Sprinkle cheddar
cheese over top. Combine dressing or bread
crumbs with butter and sprinkle over top.
Bake at 350° at least 30 minutes, or until
desired doneness. Serves 6-8.
NOTE: This recipe can be prepared and
refridgerated over night. Warm a bit before
baking or add a few minutes to baking
time.
